expected.seam_tolerance_basis: The operand record's 2e-5 mm is an intersection tolerance, imported as a 1e-5 zone tolerance. Constant-radius preparation uses four times that edge zone tolerance (4e-5); crease sewing carries it to the seam, and record export doubles the zone to an 8e-5 intersection tolerance. Cap that metadata at 8e-5 independently of measured gaps. The seams themselves are exact straight cylinder/plane or plane/plane intersections: require every sampled distance plus its rounding bound within the same 1e-9 mm absolute positional allowance used for their endpoints, independently of the stored edge tolerance. This is a sampled regression check, not a whole-edge certificate.
